args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy. The rollback endpoint was unavailable (503, persisted after retries), so the previous healthy production release v2.3.0 was redeployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) via the deploy tool instead. Rollout verified. Incident opened to track investigation of the v2.3.1 failure and confirm full recovery.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

**Rollback:** checkout-api was failing health checks after deploy v2.3.1 (unhealthy in production). The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**. The rollback endpoint was persistently unavailable (503 after retries), so I redeployed v2.3.0 via the deploy tool instead — since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production, no change-manager approval was required. The deploy succeeded in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was verified.

**Current status:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions (error rate 0.2%).

**Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), paged the on-call engineer, documenting the v2.3.1 failure, the unavailable rollback endpoint, and the redeploy workaround used for recovery.
